vocabulary.meaning: the system of linked pages and resources accessed over the internet
examples: World Wide Web is an important idea when discussing world Wide Web.
Learning about World Wide Web can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: a clickable connection that takes a user from one digital page or resource to another
examples: People often have different views about hyperlink when discussing world Wide Web.
Understanding hyperlink can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: software used to access and view websites
examples: The topic of world Wide Web raises useful questions about browser.
We can discuss how browser affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: a collection of related web pages available under one domain
examples: Website can play an important role in debates about world Wide Web.
Different countries may deal with website in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: the global network of connected computers and digital systems
examples: A discussion about world Wide Web can include the effects of internet.
Knowing the meaning of internet makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: a single document or page viewed through a web browser
examples: Web page is useful vocabulary for talking about world Wide Web.
We can use the idea of web page to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
